newsitem.title: UK: YTV shares rebound from recent lows.
newsitem.headline: YTV shares rebound from recent lows.

text.p: Shares in Yorkshire Tyne-Tees Plc rose on Wednesday in a rebound from recent weakness, market-makers said.

The stock was up 30p or 2.7 percent at 11.27-1/2 stg by 1545 GMT in thin volume of 82,867 shares. Yesterday it touched a low of 10.90 stg, equalling its lowest level since last June and well below its 12-month high of 13.30 stg set last November.
"It has been a bit bombed out and this is just a bit of a recovery," said one market-maker.

YTV shares came under pressure earlier this month amid worries about the impact of competition from digital television, following the formation of two consortia to launch digital services later this year.
